name: Keybinds Cheatsheet
description: A cheatsheet of every NoteDeck command and its current keybinding, shown with the same display names as the command palette (in the current UI language) and grouped into collapsible sections by prefix (note- / column- / quick- etc.). Shortcuts are formatted as Ctrl+Shift+K and overridden commands are marked with a pencil icon. Filter by command name or ID substring; commands without a shortcut are collected under "Unassigned". Read-only, never changes your settings. No token setup required.
